gates.recheck_command: Run the Windows Android single-device acceptance bundle for the pinned APK and device.

gates.blocking_reason: The target host has no Kubernetes cluster or independent MinIO source/target endpoints; its q19 Compose Prometheus is only a single-node observation and not release-scoped evidence.
dependencies: Kubernetes cluster with two schedulable nodes
gates.recheck_command: Run performance-environment-smoke with --require-kubernetes, a real Deployment, API, nodes, target and Prometheus, then make minio-dr-acceptance with independent endpoints.

Run scripts/n7-intelligence-acceptance.py with --require-ai --llm-config-id <id> --require-vision --require-thinking and --timeout above the 60s backend LLM timeout, then confirm model discovery, connection and editable drafts.

Run scripts/n6-project-asset-acceptance.py with --allow-mutations --execute --require-role-matrix against a controlled target, verify case-to-suite-to-plan-to-run-to-report-to-defect links and ordinary-role isolation, then clean all objects.

Run scripts/n7-intelligence-acceptance.py with --allow-mutations --require-role-matrix --require-ai --require-vision --require-thinking --timeout 150, then confirm Hermes citations, editable drafts and cleanup.

Run scripts/n8-system-governance-acceptance.py with --require-role-matrix --allow-mutations --rollback --require-rollback against the target deployment, then retain the redacted report; the revision stays in audit history by design.
